newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telefonica to bid for part of Brazil's CRT.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to bid for part of Brazil's CRT.

text.p: Spanish telecommuncations firm Telefonica de Espana intends to bid for up to 6.0 percent of Brazilian state telephone company Companhia Riograndense de Telecomunicacoes, Telefonica President Juan Villalonga said.

Villalonga told reporters on a visit to Brasilia that Telefonica would join Citibank and Porto Allegre television company Grupo RBS in bidding for a slice of a 35 percent share in CRT the Rio Grande do Sul state government intends to sell off.
Villalonga said Telefonica hoped to use CRT as a springboard for further telecommunications investments in Mercosur and the rest of Latin America.
"It is part of our strategy to buy up minority stakes in Chile, Peru and all other countries of Latin America," he said.
